aboutGame.title: What is Battleplan?
paragraphs: Battleplan is a historical World War II real-time strategy game from developer Foolish Mortals Games Inc. and publisher Slitherine Ltd. Instead of micromanaging individual soldiers, you command entire divisions: you customize an order of battle, draw multi-stage plans directly onto the map, and let your officers carry them out.

Battles in Battleplan are simulated second by second and can run from a week to a full month of in-game time across battlefields built from real-world geographic data. Manage supply lines, officer veterancy, and terrain while hundreds of thousands of troops execute your plan or expose your mistakes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Battleplan.

items.question: What is Battleplan?
items.answer: Battleplan is a historical WW2 real-time strategy game from developer Foolish Mortals Games Inc. and publisher Slitherine Ltd., released on October 12, 2026. You command entire divisions, draw battle plans directly onto the map, and watch your officers execute them in battles simulated second by second.

items.question: Is Battleplan hard for beginners?
items.answer: Battleplan rewards planning over fast clicking. Start with the Battleplan Beginner Guide to learn the order of battle, the map-drawing tools, supply management, and time controls before you take on month-long campaigns.

items.question: How long does a Battleplan battle take?
items.answer: Missions in Battleplan are simulated second by second and can run from roughly one week to a full month of in-game time, so you can pause, play in real time, or fast-forward whenever you like.

items.question: What are Battleplan's system requirements?
items.answer: Battleplan runs on 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 with DirectX 11. Minimum specs call for 4 GB RAM and a GeForce GT 1030-class GPU, while the recommended tier asks for 8 GB RAM and a GTX 1040-class card, with 8 GB of storage and a broadband connection.

items.question: How much does Battleplan cost?
items.answer: Battleplan launched on Steam on October 12, 2026 at a base price of $29.99, and it is a single-player game.
